Container.Name: kvasir
Container.Overview: Kvasir — one page that answers which AI agent to start for a given task. Aggregates three live sources: Artificial Analysis (Intelligence Index, cost per task and the wait to the first answer, per effort level), AI Stupid Level (model drift over time) and GitHub Copilot's models-and-pricing docs (availability and price). Every reading is archived in SQLite under /data, so the page shows today's answer and keeps the history behind it.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the page and the API

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite archive of every reading — keep it, this is the history

Config.Name: AI Stupid Level interval (min)
Config.Description: How often to poll the drift source, in minutes. The free API tier allows 10 calls a day, so keep this at or above 240.

Config.Name: Artificial Analysis URL
Config.Description: Artificial Analysis model page to read the board from. Every model page carries every model; this one is only an entry point, so change it if that page is ever retired.

Config.Name: Artificial Analysis interval (min)
Config.Description: How often to re-read Artificial Analysis, in minutes. It prices a new release some hours after timing it; every three hours gets it onto the board the same morning.

Config.Name: Copilot pricing interval (min)
Config.Description: How often to re-read GitHub's models-and-pricing page.

Config.Name: AI Stupid Level API key
Config.Description: Free key from https://aistupidlevel.info/router/data-keys. Optional here: the container also reads it from secrets.env in the appdata folder, which is the copy that survives rebuilding this container. Without a key the drift scores freeze at the last good reading; the sparklines keep working either way. Free tier: 10 calls a day.

Config.Name: Disabled model families
Config.Description: Model families GitHub sells but our Copilot subscription does not enable. Families, not exact keys: "fable" covers Fable 5 and 5.1. Models absent from GitHub's pricing page need no entry — they are excluded automatically.

Config.Name: AI credit tiers
Config.Description: Monthly AI-credit allocations the page reports on, as Name:credits. 1 credit = $0.01.

Config.Name: Default tier
Config.Description: Tier shown to a visitor who has never picked one. Each browser remembers its own choice.

Config.Name: Default patience
Config.Description: How long the worker and the scout may keep a visitor waiting before the first answer, until they pick: fast, balanced or any. Each browser remembers its own choice.
